categories.title: On your own
categories.text: Get to know yourself, sort out your thoughts and find new perspectives.

categories.title: In pairs
categories.text: Deeper conversations, active listening and mutual understanding.

categories.title: In a group
categories.text: Ideas for teams, shared stories and common experiences.

categories.title: With children
categories.text: Creative, playful exercises for growth and communication.

now.title: Here and now
now.description: Connect with the present moment through an image that draws you in.

bridge.title: The bridge
bridge.description: Explore where you are, where you want to be and what will help you get there.

future.title: Picture of the future
future.description: Create and arrange your own visual picture of the future you want.

essence.title: To the essence
essence.description: Pick one card out of three, again and again, until only the essential remains.

challenge.title: Challenge yourself
challenge.description: Give your attention to the image you would least like to choose.

why.title: Five whys
why.description: Each new question starts from your last answer.

dialogue.title: Dialogue with a card
dialogue.description: Write an imaginary conversation. You write both sides.

coffee.title: Over coffee
coffee.description: Share associations and practise attentive listening.

story.title: Once upon a time
story.description: Take turns and build a story full of unexpected twists.

perspective.title: A matter of perspective
perspective.description: One image suggests a problem to one of you and a solution to the other.

cluster.title: Find your people
cluster.description: Discover the links between the images and form groups without words.

market.title: Values market
market.description: Name personal values, agree on trades and create a shared event.

mime.title: Without words
mime.description: Act out a secretly chosen card through movement, posture and facial expression.

trust.title: Circle of trust
trust.description: Hear different associations without having to share your personal topic.

words.title: In other words
words.description: The cards stay put. The words travel to the left.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: A hint, secret choices, and finding the storyteller's association.

mission.title: On a mission
mission.description: Random images spark ideas for a shared challenge.

detective.title: Detectives
detective.description: Three visible details become clues to a secretly chosen card.

draw.title: Draw it on
draw.description: Imagine the world beyond the edges of the card and draw it.

gift.title: A gift
gift.description: Choose a symbolic gift by thinking about what would make the other child happy.

feelings.title: I feel
feelings.description: Place the images next to the feelings you connect them with.

adaptation.now: Each of you picks a card for your own state and a second one for how you communicate with each other.
adaptation.bridge: Agree on a shared topic. Each of you builds your own bridge; compare them at the end.
adaptation.future: Choose cards for a shared future and bring them together in one composition.
adaptation.default: A participant and an observer. The observer listens without interpreting, choosing or offering solutions.
Share one after another around the circle. For the bridge and the future, use only a shared, agreed topic.
Short, clear questions. A child may skip their turn. Everyone decides for themselves what the card means.

brand.book: Based on the book by Yana Avramova
brand.coverAlt: Cover of “Working with Metaphorical Cards” by Yana Avramova

library.title: Exercises
library.homeIntro: Pause for a moment. Look at the images. Listen to your own associations.
library.intro: Practical ideas for working with metaphorical cards
library.quote: “A picture is worth a thousand words.”
library.includeAdaptations: Include the adaptations from the book
library.footer: The images have no predefined meaning. You decide what they mean to you.

deck.title: Card decks
deck.intro_one: {{count}} card · Choose an image to take a closer look.
deck.intro_other: {{count}} cards · Choose an image to take a closer look.
deck.favoritesEmpty: Add favorite cards from the enlarged view of an image.

notes.title: My notes
notes.intro: Thoughts, stories and discoveries you want to keep.
notes.emptyTitle: This is where your discoveries will live.
notes.emptyText: Finish an exercise and save your reflections.
notes.drawingIncluded: The drawing is included in the export and the saved session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Everything you write is kept only in this browser, on this device.
settings.decksIntro: Choose which deck each exercise draws its cards from and, if you like, how many cards to work with. Leave the number empty to use the whole deck.
settings.limitHint: With a limit, the exercise takes random cards from the deck each time, but never fewer than it needs. This also applies to the pair, group and children's versions. An exercise in progress keeps its cards.
settings.backupHint: The backup contains your notes, favorite cards and unfinished exercises. Use it to move your data to another device or browser.
settings.wipeText: Deletes all notes, favorite cards and unfinished exercises from this browser.
settings.confirmRestore_one: Restore {{count}} entry from the file? Current data with the same names will be replaced.
settings.confirmRestore_other: Restore {{count}} entries from the file? Current data with the same names will be replaced.
settings.restorePartial: Some of the data couldn't be saved.
settings.restoreInvalid: This file isn't a valid backup.
settings.confirmWipe: Delete all notes, favorite cards and unfinished exercises? This can't be undone.

workspace.saveFailed: We couldn't save this exercise – your browser's storage is full. Delete or download some older notes and try again.

finish.prompt: Take a moment for what you want to take with you.
finish.question: What did you discover in this exercise?

workspace.chooseHint: {{picked}} / {{total}} chosen · Tap a chosen card again to put it back.

topic.label: What would you like to explore?

workspace.stayWithCard: Stay with the card you chose and look for your own answers.

now.pick: Choose the card that draws you in most right now.

look.title: Look at the card
questions: What is happening in the image?
What feeling does it stir in you?

self.title: Find yourself in it
questions: What in the card most reflects how you are right now?
Is there a detail, image or feeling in which you recognize something of yourself?
Is there something you hadn't noticed before you chose it?

sentences.title: Finish the sentences
sentences: What's on my mind most at the moment is…

important.title: What matters most
questions: Of everything you discovered, what matters most to you right now?

challenge.pick: Choose the card you'd least like to choose.

look.title: Look at the card
questions: What about it pushes you away?
What feeling does it stir in you?
What in this image would you rather avoid?

perspective.title: Another perspective
questions: Beyond what pushes you away, irritates or scares you, is there anything you could read differently?
Is there anything about it you actually like?

again.title: Choosing again
questions: Would this still be the last card you'd choose?

labels: Where do I want to be?
hints: What is my current situation? How do I feel?
What does the future I want look like? How will I know I'm there?
What resources, qualities or steps will help me?
bridge.leadDraw: Draw one card for each position on the bridge.
bridge.leadWhole: Look at the three cards as one whole picture.
bridge.wholePair: What similarities, differences and shared possibilities do you see?
bridge.wholeSolo: What do you see when you look at the three cards as one whole picture?

essence.leadTopic: Put into words the question you want to get to the heart of.
essence.leadRoundOver: Round {{round}} is over. The cards you kept move on to the next round.
essence.leadPick1: Look at the three cards. Which one resonates most with your question?
essence.leadPick2: The next step will bring you closer to the heart of it.
essence.leadFinal: This is the card that remains. What is it telling you?
essence.question: Your question at this stage:
essence.nextRoundNote_one: In round {{round}} you'll again pick one of three, only from this {{count}} card.
essence.nextRoundNote_other: In round {{round}} you'll again pick one of three, only from these {{count}} cards.
essence.pickNote: As soon as you pick a card, we'll move on to three new ones to get to what matters most.
essence.title: The essence
essence.connection: How do you connect it with the topic you started from?
essence.newIdea: What new thought comes to you as you look at it now?
essence.action: Is there something you feel like doing?

why.lead: Pick a card for the {{ord}} “why” and answer the question.
why.leadDone: Go back to your topic. Which answer surprised you the most?
why.step: Why is this important to me?
why.topicFirst: First write down your topic, then draw one of the hidden cards.
why.question: Why is “{{prev}}” important to me?

dialogue.firstLine: What do you want to show me?
inspiration: What do you see in me?
What is important for me to know right now?
What advice would you give me?
dialogue.leadStart: Write down your topic and draw a hidden card.
dialogue.lead: Have a conversation with your card. Write freely, without censoring the answers.
dialogue.drawHint: Tap the card to draw it.
dialogue.cardPlaceholder: What comes to mind, speaking as the card?
dialogue.sentenceTitle: Mark the sentence that touched or surprised you the most.
dialogue.reflection: What did you discover in this conversation?

story.lead: The cards are hidden. Take turns and keep what has already been told.
story.leadDone: The story is ready. Give it a title.
story.addLabel: Add 2–3 sentences inspired by the new card.
story.flipHint: Tap the card for turn {{n}} to turn it over.
story.titleLabel: What will the story be called?
story.twistLabel: Which twist surprised you the most?

coffee.pick: Participant {{n}}: pick an image that grabs you.
coffee.storyLabel: What drew you in? What associations, memories or wishes does the image stir up?
coffee.summaryLabel: Listener: So what I hear is… Did I get that right?

perspective.intro: One and the same card for a problem and its solution.
perspective.solution: Participant {{n}} · A solution from the same image
perspective.question: One clarifying question
perspective.clarify: Answer and build on the idea
perspective.changedLabel: Which of the cards you used do you now see differently?

cluster.intro: Sort the cards into groups without words. After five minutes, talk about the connections.
cluster.experience: How did you manage to understand each other without words? What surprised you? What helped each of you find your place?

feelings.intro: Draw a card and place it by one feeling or between two. You can swap your card.
feelings.explanations: This card reminds me of…, because…
feelings.connections: Does anyone see a different feeling in any of the cards?
feelings.experience: A person feels this way when…

words.round: Round {{n}} · The cards stay. The words move to the left.
words.link: How do I connect the word to my card?
words.pass: Pass the words to the left
words.change: Did passing the words change the way you see your card?

market.capacity: 55 cards allow up to 18 participants with three cards each.
market.pickValue: Tap a card to choose the one value that matters most to you.
market.groupTask: Group {{n}} (participants {{members}}): how will you make room for everyone's value? Write down 3 concrete solutions.

trust.intro: Split into groups of 4–6. Your personal topic can stay private.
trust.listen: Participant {{n}} · Listen and take what feels meaningful to you.
trust.rules: Speak for yourself. No guessing the personal topic, no interpreting the person, no advice.
trust.myImage: What do I see in my images?
trust.voice: Voice {{n}}: I see… / It reminds me of… / To me, these images…
trust.takeAway: What do I take from what I heard?

mission.ideasText: Come up with at least three ideas from details, shapes, moods or associations.
mission.solutionText: Combine inspiration from all three cards into one shared solution.
mission.presentText: Present your solution. Another team asks one question.
mission.lead: Put the shared challenge into words and split the participants into teams.
mission.teams_one: {{count}} team · each team gets three hidden cards.
mission.teams_other: {{count}} teams · each team gets three hidden cards.
mission.howCards: How did each card contribute to the solution?
mission.question: One question from another team

draw.pick: Choose a card to build a world around.
draw.beyond: What lies beyond the edges of the card?
draw.hint: Draw around the image. Who or what might be nearby?
draw.myWorld: What did you add? What in the card gave you these ideas?

gift.givesTo: Participant {{from}} gives a gift to participant {{to}}
gift.think: Think about what the other child likes, what they dream of and what would make them happy.
gift.giftLine: I'm giving you this card because I know you love…
gift.recipient: Recipient: what does this gift mean to me? (optional)
gift.feeling: How did it feel to choose a gift and to receive one?

future.pick: Choose 5–7 cards for the future you want to explore.
future.arrangeTitle: Arrange the cards freely on the table.
future.arrangeHint: Move each card. We keep its exact position.
future.descriptionLabel: If you had to describe this picture in a few words, what would they be?
future.titleLabel: Give your picture of the future a title.
future.titlePlaceholder: If your future were a film, what would it be called?

answers.В момента най-много ме занимава…: What's on my mind most at the moment is…
answers.Къде искам да бъда1: Where do I want to be?
answers.Къде искам да бъда4: Where do I want to be? (participant 2)

shell.resumed: You're picking up where you left off last time.
shell.observer: Observer: a clarifying question or a summary
shell.observerPrompts: “Tell me more…” · “Did I understand you correctly?”
shell.facilitator: Facilitator mode · Live conversation, one shared device
shell.optional: · Taking part and sharing are optional.
shell.footer: Based on “Working with Metaphorical Cards” by Yana Avramova · p. {{page}} · You decide what an image means. · Your answers are saved automatically in this browser.

trade.title: Propose a swap
trade.rule: A swap only happens when both people agree. Everyone keeps exactly three cards.

guess.introAssociations: Each private hand is viewed in turn. Pass the device to the active participant.
guess.introDetective: Six cards. The detective secretly picks one and prepares three visible details as clues.
guess.introMime: The chosen image is acted out without words or sounds. Everyone else guesses after the performance.
guess.lookAway: Everyone else looks away. Close the private view before you pass the device on.
guess.hintLabel: Give a word or a short phrase as a hint
guess.mimeTiming: One minute to prepare, then one minute to perform.
guess.observer: Observer {{n}}: pick your guess and lock it in.
guess.intentDetective: Name the three details. What was easier: coming up with clues or guessing?
guess.intentMime: What did you want to convey? What did the others notice?

adapted.topicPlaceholder: What would you like to explore together?
adapted.cardMyState: A card for how I am
adapted.cardOurCommunication: A card for how we communicate
adapted.inspectSelected: Take a closer look at the selected card
adapted.futureMeet: Where do our wishes meet? How do our differences find their place?
adapted.futureName: What will we call our shared picture?
adapted.seeInImage: What do I see in this image?
adapted.compare: Which possibilities help everyone? What's similar, and what's different?
adapted.problem: Participant {{n}}: what imaginary problem does the image suggest?
adapted.solution: Participant {{n}}: a solution, and the detail that suggests it
adapted.conditions: Under what conditions would the suggested solutions be helpful?
adapted.coffeeTitle: Participant {{n}} shares. The next person listens and sums it up.
adapted.story: What drew you to the card, and what associations did it bring up?
adapted.listener: Participant {{n}}: What I'm hearing is… Did I understand you correctly?
adapted.confirmation: Confirm, add to, or correct it
adapted.stateToday: Today I feel… What in the card reminds you of that?
adapted.stateCard: What in the card reflects how I am?
adapted.communication: How do I experience our communication?
adapted.similarities: What's similar and what's different in our experiences?
